items.headline: Nutanix reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, with ARR of $2.43 billion up 15% year over year and revenue of $703.1 million up 10%; the company also said non-GAAP EPS beat estimates.
Markets Insider lists Nutanix Q3 fiscal 2026 financial results as a recent headline within the last few hours, indicating an earnings-related catalyst.
